description: Curated practitioner view, not an official MITRE mapping. Precise-pattern technique frequency across the 56 content-verified Insane-rated Hack The Box walkthroughs (of 529). Keyword/tag-derived from walkthrough text; lower-bound evidence. Scores normalize to the maximum (54 machines) within the Insane subset; 100 is not 100% prevalence. ATT&CK v19.2 IDs/tactics. Compare across the Easy/Medium/Hard/Insane layers to see how technique mix shifts with difficulty. Provenance: 529-machine uniform mine, 2026-09-26.
